newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish expenditure to grow around 4% in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Spanish expenditure to grow around 4% in 1998.

text.p: Spain is planning to increase its 1998 state spending by around four percent, a rate lower than the nominal expected gross domestic product growth.

"The central state budget deficit will be around 2.1 percent of the gross domestic product in 1998, with public expenditure rising around four percent, below the nominal GDP rate," the Economy Ministry said.
The expected 1998 nominal GDP stands at 82 trillion pesetas versus 78.66 trillion expected in 1997.
Spain has approved and presented to the EU commission a convergence plan, which forecast the state deficit to GDP would fall to 2.1 percent in 1998 from 2.5 percent this year.
